scope: Replace rounded point-to-millimetre conversion 0.3528 with exact 25.4/72. No font, template, layout, shaping, or content changes.

regression.oracle: Independent 36000 EMU/mm against canvas millimetre bounds, not the production conversion constant.
regression.coverage: Arial's explicit Liberation Sans fallback plus native Poppins Light and Lora, each at 10/18/45pt; longest explicit line; plain/styled wrapping one EMU below and at fit, with and without default insets; maximum fitting word font.
regression.baseline: EXPECTED_FAIL: underreported widths, missed wraps and over-large maximum fitting font.
regression.retained_harness_failures: Initial v1/v2 asserted an incorrect font fallback identity; failed logs retained locally and corrected to the existing explicit Arial-to-Liberation-Sans contract. No font source changes or skips.

review.adversarial: No actionable findings in the narrow unit-conversion change
review.blind_visual: Reused prior evidence only through proven pixel identity; no repeated reviewer request
review.limitations: Retained corpus equivalence is not proof that arbitrary near-boundary text is unchanged. Existing wrapping remains approximate shaping. Typed refusals are not visual approvals.

closure: Bead remains in progress until full local race and every exact-commit CI workflow is terminal success. Publication-time statuses are immutable.
